query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_team_reads WHERE reader = $4 AND call_key = $5) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages c WHERE c.channel_id = $1 AND seq > GREATEST((SELECT CASE WHEN $3 THEN t.lead_last_read_seq ELSE m.last_read_seq END FROM agent_teams t LEFT JOIN agent_team_members m ON m.conversation_id = $4 WHERE t.id = $2), COALESCE((SELECT max(s) FROM agent_team_reads r, unnest(r.seqs) AS s WHERE r.reader = $4), 0)) AND (($3 AND to_kind IN ('lead', 'team')) OR (NOT $3 AND ((to_kind = 'member' AND to_conversation = $4) OR to_kind IN ('members', 'team')))) AND NOT (c.type = 'person_message' AND c.body->>'member' = '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM idempotency i WHERE i.team_copy_channel = c.channel_id AND i.team_copy_seq = c.seq AND i.execution_status IN ('queued', 'delivered')))) AS "new!"
